edits.old: the deployment of the read, which follows the service deployment.
edits.new: the deployment of the read, which follows the service deployment. The DP04 expected-by time is carried as 08:00, the value decision log DL11 assumed, until the data steward records it in the data_product row (GAP-0511). Every deployment value, threshold and timing of the read is a named chart value set per environment, and its fixture owner is named at the wave 2 entry check (GAP-0513).

The treatment record is the live `treatment` row of RWB-S2-E2010-APP in schema rwb_treatment; the dated `dp_treatment` copy is P1's, built from this service's events, is read only for reporting and is never the source of a treatment (GAP-1716).

  Scenario: AC9 A claim whose case_id names no case is answered with that case_id, resolves nothing and writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a claim in the window of 2026-12-14 whose case_id names no case
    When the changed-window read is called for 2026-12-14
    Then the answer carries the case_id of that claim and resolves no case
    Then the read writes no row, decision record, outbox row or state

  Scenario: AC10 The provided operations answer 401 and 404 with no items (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call to GET /api/recovery/guarantee/v1/guarantee-claims without credentials
    When the call is made
    Then the answer is 401 and no items
    Then a call to a path under /api/recovery/guarantee/v1 that names no resource is answered 404 and no items
    Then the message of the 401 and 404 answers is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S3-E2010-APP-AC10)
